summary: Falls Fire Lookout Tower, a metal observation tower mapped in Alberta near Falls Lookout Ridge; map sources say access is restricted, and no public source gives its history or condition.

access.note: Mapcarta says access is restricted and requires permission; OpenStreetMap tags access as private. No source read describes a visitor route or says the public may climb.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief records 5.0 m; the only height source read (OpenStreetMap) says 4. Neither is confirmed by a public source, so the story gives the OpenStreetMap figure with its attribution and facts.height_m uses 4.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two map-derived sources (OpenStreetMap, Mapcarta). No agency, heritage, news or booking source was found after two searches and reads. Reddit (r/firelookouts) and AllTrails could not be read; a Reddit thread title (search snippet only, not used) places the tower south of Nordegg. The brief's built 1985, height 5.0 m, elevation 2462.6 m and standing status come from the Alberta FRIAA WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT layer, whose metadata marks the data Protected and not for public display, so none of those values is cited or published here. During research I queried five rows of that layer only to read its field names. Editor to decide whether Alberta Wildfire can supply a public build date. Brief access 'closed' is not stated by any source read; Mapcarta says restricted and requires permission, so facts.access is set to permission.
